body:
Real arithmetic/comparison operator support (+/-/*////=/>=/<=/>/<) as real C infix syntax, closing the 'no literals' half of a previously-flagged gap. Found and fixed 2 more real, separate gaps while verifying: (1) an arithmetic result is a real unboxed int but this emitter declares every function/let-binding char* -- new emit-i32-boxed reinterprets via a real (char*)(intptr_t) cast, verified as a genuine value round-trip via a new driver that actually calls the compiled function and asserts the real returned value (15), not just 'compiles clean'. (2) emit-body-forms always started its body walk at a hard-coded index 3, so a defn with an explicit ': ReturnType' annotation (the exact shape most real functions in this codebase use) had its own colon/type/at/region children wrongly walked as extra bogus body statements -- new body-start-index detects and skips the annotation. 4 new tests (19 total for domain 4). Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost test binaries + bazel build clean. Still open: nested calls as arguments, match/cond as an entire defn body, defstruct not walked at top level. PARENA commit 7254e74.

⚓ ☃
title: selfhost/emit.prn: binary-op support + real value-boxing + return-annotation fixes
